training.sampling: seeded uniform Train scene then uniform query sampling with replacement
training.loss: mean visible-direction Laplace NLL for V plus mean all-direction Laplace NLL for A
training.frozen: all upstream, local observation/mean-ray, FP, and modality log-scale parameters

head.input: frozen observation predictor penultimate128 feature plus ray sin/cos; no candidate/GT/IDs
head.architecture: shared per-ray Linear130->32 GELU Linear32->1 per modality
head.basis: bounded normalized targets; floor for numerical stability; verify Train range before smoke
